## Pins

| Pin | Anchor on node `E` | Lead direction | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `<A>` | `<bin 1>` | left | <input A> |
| `<Y>` | `<bout>` | right | <output> |

The first pin (`<A>`) is the one the element is snapped to the grid by.
Every pin tip lies on the 0.25 cm grid.

## Rendering

- **Symbol:** <CircuiTikZ shape, or plain TikZ in `[module]` units>, from
  `toolbox/elements/<registry key>.tex`.
- **Leads:** drawn by the toolbox, <one module | one grid step> long.
- **Text on the element:** <pin labels, element name in the mono font>.
- **Logic levels:** each lead is coloured by `set_level(pin, 0 | 1)` or
  `level_anim(...)`, in the low and high roles.

## Exports

| Output | Path | Made by |
|---|---|---|
| SVG, PDF, standalone TeX | `exports/elements/<registry key>.svg|.pdf|.tex` | `uv run python -m manimations.toolbox.export` |
| Gallery card | `gallery/<registry key>.png` | `uv run python -m manimations.toolbox.gallery <registry key>` |

The standalone `.tex` needs `circuitstyle.sty` (exported beside it) and
compiles with XeLaTeX.
